title: Characterize remaining 12 high-feasibility npm Layer 2 families
description:
After the 2026-09-20 Python high-feasibility pass plus installed npm ulid, remaining HIGH gold-set candidates without gold/<family>/ are node packages not in package.json:

base_x, card_validator, email_validator, graphlib, ieee754, isemail, jsonpointer, jsonschema, nanoid, punycode, semver_diff, unidecode

Same 8-step loop. Adding them requires installing those packages for live_probe/characterize. Do not grow INTENDED_GOLD_SET or the registry. Do not add factory wrappers.

Also remaining: medium public-API families (100 high/medium total). Product is still characterization; 0 qualified.

See reports/audit/characterization-comparison.md.
close_reason: 12 remaining high-feasibility npm families now have gold/<family>/ and pass characterize.py. Remaining high=0.

title: Goal: characterize remaining high-feasibility Layer 2 families with before/after
description:
## Why
User agreed to the characterization procedure and asked to record baseline, execute all do-steps (not don't-steps), record end state, and compare.

## Done when
Baseline snapshot exists. Remaining high-feasibility public-API Layer 2 families have gold/<family>/ authority+ledger+probes and pass characterize.py. Existing gold families that failed the 8-step bar are fixed. No factory wrappers, no registry growth, no held-out leaks, no recipe schema behavioral fields. After snapshot compared to baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Before/after comparison committed; new gold families pass characterize; INTENDED_GOLD_SET unchanged; tests pass; 0 qualified.
notes: Python high remaining set + ulid done. gold 32→51. 12 npm high families remain (not in package.json). Comparison at reports/audit/characterization-comparison.md. 0 qualified. Registry still 396.
close_reason: Baseline recorded, remaining high-feasibility Layer 2 families characterized, don'ts held, before/after comparison committed. 0 qualified. Remaining work is medium-feasibility public-API families.

title: Phase 11: characterize next high-feasibility Layer 2 cohort
description:
## Why
Phases 0–10 withdrew replacement and characterized the intended qualification gold set (17 families). ADR 0005 made characterization the product. Original Phase 2 still owed the best ~30 Layer 2 specs as reviewed authorities, not just mechanical oracles.

## Done when
The 15 remaining high-feasibility, public-API, deep Layer 2 families from the autopsy (operator, pprint, html, msgpack, ntpath, bisect, ipaddress, posixpath, decimal, keyword, string, calendar, fractions, csv, elementtree) have gold/<family>/ authority + reviewed ledger + live probes. Oracles deepened from public docs + black-box probes only. Qualification gold-set (INTENDED_GOLD_SET) is unchanged. 0 packages marked qualified.
acceptance_criteria: 15 new gold/<family>/ trees pass characterize.py; make characterize-gold passes; autopsy gold_characterization_accepted includes them; INTENDED_GOLD_SET unchanged; tests pass.
close_reason: 15 high-feasibility Layer 2 families characterized under gold/<family>/ (authority+ledger+probes). INTENDED_GOLD_SET unchanged. 0 qualified. make characterize-gold and make test pass.

title: Phase 1: JSON format spike (authority vs oracle)
description:
## Why
ZSDL is a compact oracle DSL, not a reviewable authority document. Zero-arg wrappers made the implementation export the test.

## Done when
One gold package (JSON) has: Markdown characterization, compiled public-API oracle calling dumps/loads with arguments, held-out vectors the synthesizer never sees, no zero-arg wrappers. Layer 2 json.zspec.zsdl can be the public oracle.
acceptance_criteria: JSON package.md (or equivalent) + public-API oracle + held-out file + cleanroom_json graded on dumps/loads, not json_loads_int.
close_reason: JSON gold-set spike shipped: gold/json/package.md, dumps/loads public oracle, held-out outside zspecs/, held_out_guard. theseus_json 22/22 + 14/14 held-out. Not qualified.

title: Withdraw qualification claims from registry and docs
description:
## Why
README, AGENTS.md, architecture.md, and theseus_registry.json currently advertise hundreds of verified replacements.

## Done when
Registry carries a ladder block with qualification_claim=withdrawn; user-facing docs stop claiming qualified replacements; a withdrawn-verified list is generated.
close_reason: Registry ladder.qualification_claim=withdrawn; README/AGENTS/architecture updated.

title: Publish ADR 0001 verification ladder
description:
## Why
status=verified currently means isolation plus N listed invariants. That is not qualification.

## Done when
docs/decisions/0001-verification-ladder.md defines inventoried through qualified, withdraws qualification claims, and points at the autopsy.
close_reason: ADR 0001 committed.

title: Write reproducible corpus autopsy classifier
description:
## Why
Classification must be regenerable from zspecs/ and theseus_registry.json, not a one-off spreadsheet.

## Done when
tools/corpus_autopsy.py classifies oracle quality, contract shape, feasibility, and duplicate families; tests cover fixtures; make corpus-autopsy writes reports/audit/.
close_reason: Classifier, tests, make corpus-autopsy, and committed autopsy reports.

title: Phase 0: corpus autopsy and verification ladder
description:
## Why
Theseus scaled a toy isolation gate into hundreds of 'verified' clean-room packages. The refresh starts by classifying the corpus and replacing that boolean with a verification ladder.

## Done when
Autopsy of every ZSDL spec and registry package is committed, ADR 0001 defines the ladder and withdraws qualification claims, follow-up issues exist for Phases 1-4, and no new packages were added.
acceptance_criteria: Autopsy JSON/MD committed; ADR 0001 committed; registry ladder.qualification_claim=withdrawn; README/AGENTS no longer claim 392 qualified replacements.
close_reason: Phase 0 complete: autopsy, ADR 0001, qualification withdrawn, follow-ups filed.

title: Repair 29 medium public-API oracles that fail the installed library
description: These medium public-API Layer 2 families have no gold/<family>/ tree because characterize.py fails their public oracle against the installed library. Do not read implementation source. Fix expected values or call shapes from public docs plus live probes, then add gold trees. Families: abc, abc_meta, argparse_formatters, attrs, collections_namedtuple, contextlib_suppress, contextvars, dataclasses_field, datetime_timedelta, email_errors, email_header, email_message, email_policy, email_utils, functools_lru, gzip, http_cookies, locale, plistlib, re_patterns, stringprep, tarfile, urllib_response, urllib_robotparser, xml_dom, xml_minidom, xml_parse, xml_sax, zipfile. Not qualification. 0 qualified.
acceptance_criteria: Each listed family either has an accepted gold tree whose public oracle passes, or a ledger note explaining why the spec cannot be repaired from public docs and live probes.
close_reason: All 88 medium public-API families have accepted gold trees. 29 oracles were repaired against the installed library. 0 qualified.

title: Characterize remaining medium-feasibility public-API Layer 2 families
description: High-feasibility Layer 2 characterization is done (remaining high=0). 88 medium public-API gold-set candidates still lack gold/<family>/. Same ADR 0003 loop. Do not grow INTENDED_GOLD_SET or the registry. 0 qualified. See reports/audit/characterization-comparison.md.
notes: 2026-09-21: 59 medium families characterized (gold trees, oracles pass). 29 remain blocked on oracle repair theseus-aqo. 0 qualified.
close_reason: All 88 medium public-API families have accepted gold trees. 29 oracles were repaired against the installed library. 0 qualified.

title: Phase 10: honest product ship after the kill gate
description:
## Why
Phase 4 decides the product. Phase 10 ships that decision: README, AGENTS, user guide, and scoreboard match reality.

## Done when
Public docs describe Theseus as characterization/oracle corpus and/or slow gold-set qualification; package-count is not the scoreboard; PLAN next steps match.
acceptance_criteria: README/AGENTS/PLAN/user-guide headline match Phase 4 ADR; no inflated verified-as-qualified claim.
close_reason: README/AGENTS/PLAN/USER_GUIDE/architecture honest: 0 qualified, characterization is the product.

title: Phase 9: pinned characterization and qualification skills
description:
## Why
One LLM prompt is not a lifecycle. Characterization and qualification prompts should be pinned skills, not ad-hoc synthesize_waves text.

## Done when
skills/ for characterize and qualify exist and AGENTS.md points at them; synthesizer still never sees held-out.
acceptance_criteria: skills/characterize and skills/qualify (or equivalent) committed; AGENTS index updated.
close_reason: Pinned skills/characterize and skills/qualify v1.0.0.

title: Phase 8: qualification receipts
description:
## Why
Generated source is not authority. Qualification needs content-addressed receipts (input closure, oracle hashes, isolation, two runs).

## Done when
qualify.py writes committed receipts under reports/qualification/; make qualify-check fails if stale.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt JSON committed; hashes of public spec, held-out, impl; check target exists.
close_reason: tools/qualify.py receipts + make qualify-check. Dual-gen required for qualified.

title: Phase 7: freeze factory wrappers as non-product
description:
## Why
theseus_* 3-invariant factories and rust_module wrappers must not be presented as clean-room replacements.

## Done when
Docs/CI/lint reject new gold-set factory wrappers; rust_module specs stay inventoried; wave_state is not the progress model.
acceptance_criteria: Lint or test fails new gold-set zero-arg wrappers; README/AGENTS do not present *_rust as replacement.
close_reason: tools/lint_gold_wrappers.py + reports/audit/factory-wrapper-freeze.json (394 factory specs).

title: Phase 6: registry ladder fields and qualified list
description:
## Why
status=verified is still a boolean callers treat as a gate. The ladder must be machine-readable on the registry without pretending isolation is qualification.

## Done when
theseus_registry.json exposes ladder rungs / qualified[] as the product claim; is_allowed remains isolation-compat; docs match.
acceptance_criteria: Registry schema documents ladder; qualified list is authoritative; tests cover is_allowed vs is_qualified.
close_reason: registry.is_qualified(); ladder.is_qualified false; ladder.qualified []; product=characterization.

title: Phase 5: characterization records vs recipe inventory
description:
## Why
Layer 1 recipe records are not behavioral characterization. The gold-set loop needs a first-class characterization record (API surface, oracle identity, sufficiency, uncertainty) that is not stuffed into descriptive.summary.

## Done when
A documented characterization-record shape exists (gold/<family>/ plus schema or ADR), Layer 1 recipes stay inventory, and autopsy/qualify consume the same identity fields.
acceptance_criteria: ADR or schema for characterization records; gold families validate; recipes remain inventory-only.
close_reason: ADR 0006 + schema/characterization-record.schema.json. Distinct from package recipes.

title: Phase 4: keep or drop replacement as a product claim
description:
## Why
Phase 3 is the kill gate. The project must choose characterization-only vs slow gold-set growth.

## Done when
An accepted decision updates README/AGENTS product claims. Either (a) grow qualified packages slowly via capabilities and sealed artifacts, or (b) Theseus is a characterization/oracle corpus and says so.
acceptance_criteria: ADR or PLAN update reflecting Phase 3 outcomes; README matches the decision.
close_reason: ADR 0005: characterization is the product. Kill gate fired (0/10 qualified).

title: Phase 3: gold-set regenerative qualification
description:
## Why
Theseus never ran empty-workspace regeneration against a held-out oracle. That is the existence proof for replacement.

## Done when
5-10 high-feasibility packages (json, base64, hashlib, uuid, semver, tomli, struct, binascii, urllib_parse, difflib, libpcap/pcapng, fnmatch, shlex, hmac) attempt qualification: empty workspace, hidden oracle, isolation, twice. Results published without inflating package count.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification records for the attempted set; fewer than half passing means replacement is not the product claim.
close_reason: Phase 3 done: 10 Python families attempted (json + 9 theseus_*_q). Public+held-out isolation passed; independent_generation false; 0 qualified. Kill gate fired. Receipts in reports/qualification/.

title: Phase 2: characterization loop with uncertainty review
description:
## Why
Modern LLMs improve characterization only if drafts are reviewed, uncertainty is explicit, and Layer 2 oracles are deepened against the installed original.

## Done when
A characterization loop exists (docs + live probes, not implementation source in the generator). The intended gold-set Layer 2 specs are re-oracled to RFC/KAT completeness where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Documented loop; gold-set Layer 2 specs deepened; uncertainty ledger for drafts.
close_reason: Characterization loop shipped: ADR 0003, docs/characterization-loop.md, tools/live_probe.py + characterize.py, gold/<family> authority+ledgers, gold-set Layer 2 RFC/KAT deepen. Not qualified.

title: File Phase 1-4 follow-up issues
description:
## Why
Phase 0 is an autopsy. Format spike, characterization loop, gold-set qualification, and the decision gate need tracked work.

## Done when
Beads issues exist for Phases 1-4, blocked on Phase 0 completion.
close_reason: Filed theseus-bi7, theseus-il4, theseus-szl, theseus-5t6.

value: Phase 1 JSON spike (ADR 0002) is done. theseus_json is cleanroom_public_api/deep but still legacy_isolation. Held-out lives in gold/json/held_out.zspec.zsdl. Next is Phase 2 theseus-il4.

Phase 11 done: 15 high-feasibility Layer 2 families have gold/<family>/ characterization (bisect, operator, pprint, html, msgpack, ntpath, posixpath, ipaddress, decimal, keyword, string, calendar, fractions, csv, elementtree). Not INTENDED_GOLD_SET. 0 qualified.

Phase 12 medium characterization 2026-09-21: 59 medium public-API families have gold trees. 29 remain (theseus-aqo) because their Layer 2 oracles fail the installed library. 0 qualified. Cohort is 105. Intended gold set unchanged.
Dolt issue DB was reseeded from JSONL on 2026-09-18 after deleting stale origin refs/dolt/data (May 2026). Fresh history was pushed; auto-push should work again.

Phase 2 characterization (ADR 0003): gold/<family>/{package.md,uncertainty.yaml,probes.yaml}; live probes import the installed API only and must not read implementation source. tomllib aliases tomli; pcap aliases libpcap. json Layer 2 deepen must stay disjoint from gold/json/held_out tokens. characterize.py SpecLoader.load expects a Path. Qualification is still Phase 3 (theseus-szl).

Theseus status=verified is legacy isolation only (ADR 0001). Qualification is withdrawn; 0 packages qualified. Next work is Phase 1 JSON format spike (theseus-bi7): Markdown authority, public-API oracle, held-out vectors, no zero-arg wrappers.

Phase 3-10: qualification protocol cannot mark qualified without two independent empty-workspace generations. Kill gate fired 0/10. Characterization is the product (ADR 0005). Dolt issue history was discarded 2026-09-18 and reseeded from JSONL.
